verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own docs show the core of a SOC 2 program built into the platform. SOC 2 is a supported framework, and a vCISO helps create the program. Adding a framework automatically adds its controls. Formal and Comprehensive policy templates can be adapted and published, and a pentest feeds into the audit. However, nothing explicitly shows Type I versus Type II support, a Trust Services Criteria control mapping, or built-in evidence requests; the Fieldwork AI evidence collection appears on a separate marketing page. missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II workflows, documented Trust Services Criteria control library, built-in evidence-request tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end SOC 2 audit.
